fastapi>=0.115
uvicorn[standard]>=0.30
pydantic>=2.9
pydantic-settings>=2.4
slack_sdk>=3.31

# Google Calendar only, and imported lazily: CALENDAR_BACKEND=memory (the
# default) never touches them, so a partial install still runs the service.
# Gmail deliberately needs neither -- an app password covers IMAP and SMTP.
# The calendar cannot do the same: Google Calendar has no IMAP, its CalDAV
# endpoint stopped accepting basic auth years ago, and the secret iCal URL is
# read-only. OAuth is the only way to write an event.
google-api-python-client>=2.140
google-auth-oauthlib>=1.2

# Test-only. jsonschema must NOT be imported by application code:
# docs/data-contracts.md says "No validator dependency is added to application
# modules". The [format-nongpl] extra pulls rfc3339-validator, without which the
# date-time format checker is inert and timestamp assertions pass on naive
# datetimes, defeating their purpose.
pytest>=8.0
jsonschema[format-nongpl]>=4.23
httpx>=0.27
